what: D1 of the grh-lean lane, recomputed from the census output and split by the rule stated in tools/grh-lean-records.js (the rule’s words are in each edition’s rules). A list, never a verdict.

rules.words: a congruence lemma Lean’s simp makes for a function (name ends .congr_simp)
a heterogeneous congruence lemma Lean makes (name ends .hcongr_<n>)
an equation lemma Lean makes for a match (name ends .match_<n>.congr_eq_<n>)
an eliminator Lean makes for an inductive type (name ends .ctorElim or .ctorElimType)
a per-constructor eliminator Lean makes (T.c.elim, with T.ctorElim in the census)
a helper of structural recursion (name ends .brecOn.<x>)
an instance name of Lean’s automatic form (last component inst followed by a capital letter)
every other decl row: a declaration written in the release’s files
